import pandas as pd

from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
import seaborn as sns

# Load iris dataset
iris = load_iris()
df = pd.DataFrame(data=iris.data, columns=iris.feature_names)
df['species'] = iris.target

# Select only the setosa species
setosa_df = df[df['species'] == 0]

# Perform PCA to reduce dimensionality to 2D
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
pca_df = pca.fit_transform(setosa_df[['sepal length (cm)', 'sepal width (cm)', 'petal length (cm)', 'petal width (cm)']])

# Create a new dataframe with the principal components
pca_df = pd.DataFrame(data=pca_df, columns=['PC1', 'PC2'])

# Add the species column
pca_df['species'] = 'setosa'

# Load the dataset with the remaining species
other_df = df[df['species'] != 0]

# Perform PCA to reduce dimensionality to 2D
pca_other = PCA(n_components=2)
pca_other_df = pca_other.fit_transform(other_df[['sepal length (cm)', 'sepal width (cm)', 'petal length (cm)', 'petal width (cm)']])

# Create a new dataframe with the principal components
pca_other_df = pd.DataFrame(data=pca_other_df, columns=['PC1', 'PC2'])

# Add the species column
pca_other_df['species'] = other_df['species'].apply(lambda x: 'versicolor' if x == 1 else 'virginica')

# Concatenate the two dataframes
pca_df = pd.concat([pca_df, pca_other_df])

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))

plt.title('PCA of Iris Dataset')

# Create a new dataframe with the principal components
pca_df = pd.DataFrame(data=pca_df, columns=['PC1', 'PC2'])

# Add the species column
pca_df['species'] = 'setosa'

# Load the dataset with the remaining species
other_df = df[df['species'] != 0]
